method: Root examined all 63 original/new pairs decoded from the completed movies at matched timestamps, covering copper work, proof peel, title, three anatomical roundels, wash, labels and tissue ending. Independent worker checked repeated seeks.

comparison_notes: Source-informed full-length recreation with attributed complete anatomical bee/detail drawings and reusable printmaking engines. Scene assembly, camera, reveal choreography, narration, music and foley are recreated. Fine burin leaders, swarf, peel and wash behavior vary; scientific-name pronunciation is uncertain. This is not a blind model benchmark.
